newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar futures close lower, featureless.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar futures close lower, featureless.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures closed lower in light and featureless trade on Thursday, traders said.
Most active March closed down $2.60 at $304.30 having moved in a three-dollar range from a low of $303.00. May was down $2.30 at $303.30.
The two front months dominated business and traded 1,838 and 531 lots respectively.
"If anything the market should have gone up on news of Sri Lanka buying. At least it is some offtake," a trader said.
Sri Lanka has bought 12,500 tonnes of white sugar for arrival in Colombo during the second half of February, government officials said on Thursday.
Iran was thought to have bought a cargo of whites at $318 and to be looking for more, according to one trader.
There is a chance that Iraq may announce another tender as part of its oil-for-food deal, he added.
